svg.title: Technical system
svg.desc: Technical ecosystem in five layers. Languages: Java, Python, C, SQL. Web: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript. AI and Data: Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Sentence-BERT, TF-IDF, Pandas, Streamlit. Development: GitHub, VS Code. Foundations: Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms, Problem Solving.
